# Amazon

> > Amazon's global e-commerce platform, cloud computing services (AWS), Prime membership benefits, advertising solutions, and Whole Foods Market integration.

Amazon.com is the world's largest online retailer and cloud services provider through AWS (Amazon Web Services). The platform encompasses retail shopping, Prime membership benefits, AWS cloud infrastructure (EC2, S3, CDK), digital advertising, grocery delivery through Whole Foods Market, and authentication services.

## Key Topics

- Amazon Prime
- AWS (Amazon Web Services)
- Amazon EC2
- AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK)
- Amazon S3
- Whole Foods Market
- Prime Video
- Amazon Ads
- CloudFormation
- Passkey Authentication
- Prime Delivery
- AWS Tutorials
- Cloud Computing
- Lambda
- Amazon Business

## Core Services & Membership

- [Amazon Prime](https://amazon.com/amazonprime): Amazon Prime membership signup with benefits and pricing plans
- [Amazon Sign-In](https://xb-node-fe.amazon.com/glenn/home): Amazon account authentication with passkey and password sign-in
- [Whole Foods Market](https://wfm.amazon.com): Whole Foods Market homepage with Prime delivery and prepared meals

## AWS Getting Started

- [Getting Started - Cloud Computing Tutorials](https://aws.amazon.com/getting-started): AWS getting started hub with tutorials and cloud fundamentals
- [Hands-On Tutorials for AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/getting-started/hands-on): Step-by-step hands-on tutorials for getting started with AWS
- [AWS Tutorials](https://aws.amazon.com/tutorials): AWS tutorials directory for common use cases and services

## AWS Documentation & Tutorials

- [Get started with Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/EC2_GetStarted.html): EC2 getting started: launch, connect, and clean up instances tutorial
- [Create your first AWS CDK app](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/hello-world.html): AWS CDK tutorial: create first app with Lambda and CloudFormation

## About Amazon

- [AWS Origins](https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/our-origins): AWS founding story and launch of S3 and EC2 services in 2006
- [About Amazon Ads](https://advertising.amazon.com/about-us): Amazon Ads mission, brand values, and advertising solutions overview

## Support & Help

- [Amazon Ads Academy Help and FAQ](https://advertising.amazon.com/academy/help): Amazon Ads Academy FAQ for certifications and account issues
